title: 116 Old San Antonio Road

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located on the north side of IH 10, at 116 Old San Antonio Road in Boerne, Texas.

rows.label: Frontage
rows.text: 556 +/- feet on Old San Antonio Road

rows.label: Utilities
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Topography
rows.text: Property gently slopes from west to the east.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: According to FEMA maps, there does not appear to be a 100-year flood plain on the property.

rows.label: Easements
rows.text: Sewer easement and various electrical easements are on the property.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: 2024 Texas Department of Transportation maps indicate 10,657 vehicles per day on Old San Antonio Road, north of the property and 57,215 vehicles per day on IH 10, west of the property.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: The property is near many new commercial, multifamily, and residential developments.

rows.label: Potential Uses
rows.text: This property would suit a variety of commercial uses.

comments: The property has easy access to IH 10.
The Kendall County area (and Boerne in particular) continue to have very strong population growth.
The property has close proximity to Boerne Middle School South and Kendall Elementary as well as The Geneva School of Boerne.
